Verified with test_planning_state, test_ai_status, test_supervisor, and test_orchestrator_bundle.

PLAN-002 APPROVED. Reviewed planning_state.py: (1) session profile isolation confirmed — generic phase2 sessions correctly use SESSION_PROFILE_GENERIC and do not inherit blueprint-gap brief files, expected outputs, or proposed tasks; (2) legacy phase1 behavior preserved via LEGACY_SESSION_PATHS + legacy_phase_for_session() routing phase1-bootstrap and phase1-2026-04-11-backend-completion to their original phase1 directory; (3) session pointer system working — planning-session-pointer.json correctly tracks active session; (4) all 9 test_planning_state tests pass, plus 35/35 across test_ai_status/test_supervisor/test_orchestrator_bundle. Downstream BG-000 through BG-007 are unblocked.
